parsed.summary: Four results are stated. (1) A binary-code bound: the asymptotic rate R(δ) is at most the minimum of a Hamming variational rate and a Johnson-shell variational rate, and that minimum is strictly below the MRRW II rate. (2) Theorem 1.2: interlacing data with 2Γ_r > s bounds every spherical code by 2^{Rn} for each R > Φ_r, so R_sph(s) is at most the closed-constraint hierarchy infimum. (3) Corollary 1.3/7.6: the strict level hierarchy and the localized chain R_sph ≤ inf κ̄_r < κ̄_1 < κ̄_row < κ̄_0 = B_KL. (4) A numerical kissing-number claim. The most important caveat is (4): despite its name it uses `∃ᶠ` (frequently), not `∀ᶠ` (eventually), so it only asserts the bound for infinitely many n.
